# Establish a foreign subsidiary or branch

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When operating in another country requires a reviewed legal presence rather than remote sales alone. An approved local structure with completed registrations, operating authority and owned intercompany obligations.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Describe the intended foreign operation

agent-runnable


Record activities, customers, personnel, premises, management, funds and data flows. Identify the proposed start date and distinguish a subsidiary, branch, representative office and distributor arrangement.

- Sources: [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/) · [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Select the structure with local advisers

human · human approval required


Qualified legal and tax advisers assess the actual commercial need, local rules, permanent-establishment exposure, ownership and reporting. Compare alternatives and document assumptions before approving a local entity.

- Sources: [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/) · [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare formation and operating dependencies

agent-runnable


Assemble approved ownership, director, address, capital and identification records. Plan tax, payroll, banking, licensing and intercompany arrangements with owners for prerequisites.

- Sources: [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/) · [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Authorize and complete the local establishment

human · human approval required


Authorized representatives execute the reviewed documents and local advisers coordinate submissions. Retain official decisions and keep restricted activities paused until required registrations or permissions are obtained.

- Sources: [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/) · [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile local and group operations

agent-runnable


Verify the local register, bank mandates, accounting, payroll and permissions against the approved plan. Activate the reporting calendar and transfer-pricing review and retain unresolved obligations with owners.

- Verify: An approved local structure with completed registrations, operating authority and owned intercompany obligations.
- Sources: [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/) · [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf)
